moves.name: Grudgeful Bulldoze
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When there is at least one trapped Pokémon on the opponent’s field of play.
Deactivation Condition: When there are no longer any trapped Pokémon on the opponent’s field of play.

Lowers the target’s Defense and Speed by 1 stat rank. Raises the Defense and Speed of all allied sync pairs by 1 stat rank.

moves.name: I See It All!
